name: IncreasingTrend_GT
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_GT') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where (c.value - a.value) > 0.3 and (b.value >= a.value - 0.1) and (c.value >= b.value - 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: IncreasingTrend_OBS
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_OBS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated')] where (c.value - a.value) > 0.3 and (b.value >= a.value - 0.1) and (c.value >= b.value - 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: IncreasingTrend_SYS
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_SYS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where (c.value - a.value) > 0.3 and (b.value >= a.value - 0.1) and (c.value >= b.value - 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: DecreasingTrend_GT
epl: @Name('DecreasingTrend_GT') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where (a.value - c.value) > 0.3 and (b.value <= a.value + 0.1) and (c.value <= b.value + 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: DecreasingTrend_OBS
epl: @Name('DecreasingTrend_OBS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated')] where (a.value - c.value) > 0.3 and (b.value <= a.value + 0.1) and (c.value <= b.value + 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: DecreasingTrend_SYS
epl: @Name('DecreasingTrend_SYS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where (a.value - c.value) > 0.3 and (b.value <= a.value + 0.1) and (c.value <= b.value + 0.1) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: StableRegion_GT
epl: @Name('StableRegion_GT') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - a.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - c.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: StableRegion_OBS
epl: @Name('StableRegion_OBS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated')] where (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - a.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - c.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: StableRegion_SYS
epl: @Name('StableRegion_SYS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - a.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and (((a.value + b.value + c.value)/3 - c.value) between -0.5 and 0.5) and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 3

name: TrendReversal_GT
description: Ground truth trend reversal (increase followed by decrease).
epl: @Name('TrendReversal_GT') select a, b, c, d from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> d=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.value > d.value and d.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 6

name: TrendReversal_OBS
epl: @Name('TrendReversal_OBS') select a, b, c, d from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') -> d=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated')] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.value > d.value and d.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 6

name: TrendReversal_SYS
epl: @Name('TrendReversal_SYS') select a, b, c, d from pattern [every a=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> d=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.value > d.value and d.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 6
